notes.title: [v0.2.4] Bug fixes & new features
notes.notes:
NEW UPDATE IS OUT v.0.2.4

NEW FEATURES

 New daily  quests
 New crop processor upgrades
 Add minimum levels for invasions
 Possiblity to split counter measure amount


BUG FIXES

 Invasions no longer activate on locked crops
 It is no longer possible to roll equipment while already rolling one
 Hard daily quests require proper amounts now
 Locust swarm invasion is weaker
 Proper formatting for various numbers
 Equipment context menu properly displays actions
 Clicking on crops while special crop is active duration is no longer decremented


Don't forget to join the Discord!
